plugins.name: coder-agents
plugins.description: A concise shared setup for AI coding assistants, agnostic of programming languages, agent frameworks, and host tools. Ships one governance manifesto (AGENTS.md), thirteen on-demand skills (craft, confluence, domain-modeling, go-modernize, graph-engineering, grilling, performance, plan-authoring, solution-architecture, system-diagramming, teamwork, verification, wayfinder), four routine-task command workflows, and deterministic verification gates.
